listing.description_html:
Coloring time is learning time!

Made for little hands ages 1 to 3, this is more than a coloring book. Every page shows one big, friendly picture and its first word in giant letters your toddler can color too. Then kids explore colors, shapes and counting from 1 to 10, all while they scribble and have fun.

  • 40 first word pictures: animals, fruits, vehicles and everyday things
  • 8 color pages and 8 shape pages to learn the basics
  • Count and color from 1 to 10 with pictures from the book
  • Extra thick lines and single sided pages, made for chunky crayons
  • Free bonus pages: scan the code inside to print more at home

A perfect first gift for toddlers, daycare and preschool. Add it to your cart today!
